generation: Generation 2 — Capability Architecture & Symbiotic Platform Engineering

research.saturation_rule: A capability is SATURATED only after the principal representatives are covered and two consecutive revisits produce no material new architectural finding, or remaining questions require repository validation rather than external research.
research.discovery_rule: Material concepts that do not fit the current taxonomy must be registered as G2-CAPABILITY-CANDIDATE-* and classified CORE, CROSS_CUTTING, DOMAIN, PROVIDER_SPECIFIC, DUPLICATE, LOW_VALUE or N_A before promotion.
research.candidate_inventory_authority: project_docs/generation-2/research/CAPABILITY_DISCOVERY_REGISTER.md plus prior state history and capability dossiers; no prior candidate is revoked by compact state representation
research.historical_coverage_authority: project_docs/generation-2/research/REPRESENTATIVE_COVERAGE.md and capability dossiers; all prior coverage remains authoritative and unsuperseded

gates.RESEARCH_ELICITATION: All active macro-capabilities have representative coverage, discovered candidates are triaged, minimum cycles completed, and remaining external-research gaps are non-material or saturated.
gates.CAPABILITY_SYNTHESIS: Canonical capability taxonomy, subcapabilities, cross-cutting capabilities, representative coverage ledger, recurring primitives and unresolved contradictions are consolidated without implementation authority.
gates.PLANNING_A_TAXONOMY_BOUNDARIES: Capability ownership, boundaries, overlap rules and non-goals are explicit.
gates.PLANNING_B_SB_CURRENT_STATE_RECONCILIATI: Each material capability is mapped to repository truth, contracts, tests, maturity and gaps without guessing.
gates.PLANNING_C_TARGET_ARCHITECTURE: Target planes, universal primitives, provider/binding model, portable definition/IR and evidence/provenance model are coherent and decision-backed.
gates.PLANNING_D_DEPENDENCY_MIGRATION_STRATEGY: Dependency order, compatibility, migration, rollback and coexistence strategy are explicit.
gates.PLANNING_E_PRODUCT_PROOF_ACCEPTANCE: Native path, external-provider path, replaceability, portability, governance, runtime autonomy and integrated product proofs have measurable acceptance criteria.
gates.ARCHITECTURE_RECONCILIATION: Each material finding/gap has KEEP, HARDEN, GENERALIZE, PROVIDERIZE, INTEGRATE, REPLACE, DEFER or DO_NOT_BUILD disposition with evidence and dependencies.
gates.WBS_DECOMPOSITION: Architecture decisions are decomposed into small capability-oriented WBS documents with bounded scope, authority, dependencies, non-goals and proof obligations.
gates.WBS_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH: Cross-WBS dependency graph is acyclic or explicitly staged, with shared foundational work ordered before dependent domains.
gates.WORK_PACKAGE_DESIGN: Work Packages are derived from WBS, each sized for 3–10 Construction Sprints, plus integration/review and closure, with no forecast work materialized prematurely.
gates.READY_FOR_WORKER_HANDOFF: Research and planning artifacts are complete, integrated and ready for the separate :10/:30/:50 execution pipeline.
